name: fmsdisk
runtimeDependencies: AmigaOS with FMS: assigned to the virtual disk backing drawer
notes: The installed 68k driver and the complete DEVS:Mountlist match the Aminet FMS 5.01 archive.
Mountlist defines only FF0 through FF3, units 0 through 3, with double-density floppy geometry.
The fmssys entry owns the launcher, imaging tool, guides, icons and Unit0 backing image.
